definitions.full: H6608. pethach מֵּ֫תַח noun masculine opening, unfolding ; — construct ׳פ יָאִיר דְּבָרֶיךָ Psa 119:130 , so ᵐ5 and most; > Symm Jerome Bae מֶּתַח (= thy words as a doorway ).
